Passenger · Israel

Passengers of flydubai Flight 1073

flydubai Flight 10732026Developing story
Flight
flydubai Flight 1073
Date
30 September 2026
Aircraft
Boeing 737 MAX 8
Location
Tabuk, Saudi Arabia

This is a recent event and an investigation is under way. Details may change as more is confirmed.

When the wounded captain, Smit Machchhar, managed to open the cockpit door of flydubai Flight 1073, passengers rushed in. Tali Manes had raised the alarm after hearing the struggle while waiting outside the front toilet for her daughter. Her husband Tzvika Manes, Yaniv Hayun, Asaf Rajuan and Dr Shota Musayev got into the cockpit and overpowered the first officer, and Musayev treated the captain's wounds, while off-duty flydubai pilots took over and landed the plane at Tabuk. Israel's President Isaac Herzog has recommended the four men for the Presidential Award for Civilian Heroism.

Who helped

  • Tali Manes PassengerWaiting outside the front toilet for her 6-year-old daughter, she heard the struggle in the cockpit and raised the alarm.
  • Tzvika Manes PassengerRushed from the front row, got into the cockpit and helped overpower the attacker.
  • Yaniv Hayun PassengerGot into the cockpit, helped overpower the attacker and steadied the controls.
  • Asaf Rajuan PassengerGot into the cockpit and helped overpower the attacker.
  • Dr Shota Musayev PassengerHelped overpower the attacker, then gave the badly wounded captain lifesaving first aid.
